# Formal data analysis {#sec-fda}

We start by fitting the full multiple regression model containing all explanatory variables. The full model can be written as:

$$
BMI ~=~ \alpha + \beta_{AgeGroup} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{AgeGroup}(x) + \beta_{Sex} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{sex}(male) + \beta_{Employment} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Employment}(x) +  \beta_{Veg} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Veg}(Yes) + \beta_{Fruit} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Fruit}(Yes) + \beta_{Year} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Year}(x)
$$

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-lm
#| tbl-cap: Estimates of the regression model coefficient

full_model <- lm(BMI ~ AgeGroup + Sex + Employment + Veg + Fruit + Year, data = BMI_data)
tab_model(full_model,show.ci = F)
```




Looking at @tbl-lm, we can see the reduced model is:

$$
BMI ~=~ \alpha + \beta_{AgeGroup} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{AgeGroup}(x) + \beta_{AgeGroup} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{AgeGroup}(x) + \beta_{AgeGroup} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{AgeGroup}(x) + \beta_{AgeGroup} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{AgeGroup}(x) + \beta_{AgeGroup} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{AgeGroup}(x) + \beta_{AgeGroup} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{AgeGroup}(x) + \beta_{Employment} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Employment}(x) + \beta_{Employment} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Employment}(x) + \beta_{Employment} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Employment}(x) + \beta_{Employment} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Employment}(x) + \beta_{Veg} \cdot \mathbb{I}_{Veg}(Yes)
$$
